description: NOT IN THE PAPER. Asks whether the paper's distinguishable-photon control is a strong enough classical baseline. Boson sampling is super-Poissonian (Fano ~1.28) while the distinguishable control is sub-Poissonian (~0.89), so the two differ in their single-mode marginals as well as in their multi-photon correlations -- the paper's gap is not attributable to interference alone. This config runs four classical challengers that each keep more of the boson distribution's structure, against the same target and settings.
